correctness.rationale: Run decomposition fixes alternation and number of zero/one runs from 01/10 transition counts. Bounded compositions give exact fiber sizes; union of endpoint-rectangle possibilities gives all attainable profiles without duplicate counts. Summation yields the rational formal power series, pole analysis its quadratic leading term, and an exact cleared-denominator integer polynomial identity certifies the period-12 h=2 formula for every n. Binomial singleton classification proves the modular obstruction and all boundaries including h=1 and n=1,2. Standalone direct exhaustive checks for h=1..5,n=1..17 and coefficient checks h=1..20,n=1..500 were executed from the actual package paths. Finite checks supplement, not replace, proof.

originality.rationale: Material examination of the original full sequence-profile paper and its expanded text, the unrestricted Markov-type manuscript, and a subsequent substring-multispectrum reconstruction article identified general profile/Eulerian-walk theory, but no theorem giving bounded-maximal-run binary bigram profile fibers, the rational capacity generating function for all run caps, the exact period-12 h=2 count, or its singleton obstruction. Targeted semantic record queries likewise returned non-covering distinct-substring, length-five prefix-overlap, and deletion-coding claims. This is a comparison of mathematical implications, not an assertion that absence of search hits proves novelty. A hidden earlier constrained-Markov-specialization remains possible.
residual_risks: Search indexes and accessible papers cannot rule out a previously unnoticed constrained-Markov-type specialization or small-parameter table.

value.rationale: A maximal-run cap models a motivated sequence constraint and is invisible to the observed length-two profile as a simple forbidden-bigram restriction. The theorem computes an exact optimal code repertoire for every cap and block length, gives a sharp capacity coefficient and the relative price of the constraint, and distinguishes raw identifiable words from coded distinguishable messages: every admissible word is ambiguous in lengths 1 mod 6 at h=2 despite a quadratic repertoire of mutually distinguishable profiles. These are structural reconstruction and design limits, not a routine check of a supplied table.
